meta.title: Subscription limits
meta.description: Shows the used share of subscription limits (5-hour, weekly and monthly windows) and provider balances in a hover popover. Subscription plans and prepaid balances are supported; first-party ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Cursor subscriptions are not tracked. UI languages: English, Russian, Chinese, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean.
